newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Datang set to issue 1.2 bln H-shares - sources.
newsitem.headline: Datang set to issue 1.2 bln H-shares - sources.

text.p: China's Beijing Datang Power Generation Co Ltd is expected to issue about 1.2 billion H-shares at about HK$2.20 each in its dual listing in Hong Kong and London, market sources said on Tuesday.
The issue price will represent a price-earnings multiple of about 10 to 12 times on a fully diluted basis, sources said.
"About 60 percent of the issue will place internationally, 30 percent for the U.S. market and a remaining 10 percent for public offering in Hong Kong," one source said.
Sources said the company would issue additional shares, representing 15 percent of the issue, to cover overallotment.
Public offering of shares in Hong Kong is expected to run from March 11-14 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin later in March, they said.
Datang is expected to hold a company presentation on Wednesday, sources said.
Morgan Stanley is the lead manager of the issue.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
New World Infrastructure Ltd said it would buy a 9.9 percent stake in Datang at the initial public offering price yet to be set.
Datang, a subsidiary of North China Power Group Co, operates coal-fired electric power plants which supply electricity to Beijing and other industrial cities in northern China.
